Adds a place to work. Create `src/content/venues/<venue>.md` with:

```markdown
---
name: Salt City Coffee
type: cafe # cowork | cafe | free
neighborhood: Westcott
address: 123 Example St, Syracuse, NY 13210
url: https://venue.example
# pricingUrl: https://venue.example/pricing # link it — never hardcode prices
hours: check website
vibe: One line on what it's like to work there.
meetingRooms: false
added: 2026-09-25 # today's date
---
```

- [ ] You've actually worked from here (or someone you trust has)
- [ ] No dollar amounts anywhere — prices rot, links don't
